title: Q-SYS-AGENT-READINESS: SYS-5: score ultrastable.io against the agent-readiness checks as a probe
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** file:scripts/agent_readiness.py
**Status:** closed

Owner directive 2026-11-12: a system is an integrated collection of parts, not one worker and a database.

Check the live site for the standards Cloudflare's scan evaluates (robots.txt, sitemap, Link headers, markdown negotiation, content signals, API catalog, MCP server card, agent skills index, OAuth discovery where an API needs auth) and fail the loop when one regresses. Add Accept: text/markdown content negotiation to the site pages.
Paths: scripts/agent_readiness.py, site/worker.js, site/site.test.mjs.
Acceptance: the script prints a per-check result for ultrastable.io and the transparency page shows it.

size: L

**Closing probe:** file:scripts/agent_readiness.py exists and its tests pass.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 219.8 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
